summary: The E.W. Scripps Company filed an 8-K reporting entry into Amendment No. 1 to its existing credit agreement. The amendment extends the maturity of its revolving credit facility from July 7, 2027 to July 7, 2029 for aggregate commitments of up to $200 million, with a non-extended tranche of $8 million maturing on July 7, 2027. No changes to pricing, financial covenants, or borrowing capacity were disclosed beyond the maturity extension. This is a routine refinancing or amendment of a credit facility, not a special situation. Filed under Items 1.01 and 2.03. No advisor or board recommendation was mentioned. The filing reflects ordinary-course liability management.
